hint-listen.text: Tap the big sound button. Listen carefully, then say it with me. You can listen again!

hint-write.text: First, watch the moving line. Now use your finger to follow the pale letter. Go slowly. You can do it!

hint-play.text: Look at the picture. Which letter is its friend? Tap one letter. Take your time!

try-again.text: A good try! Have another look. You can listen to the sound again.

well-done.text: You found it! Lovely work. Ready for our next little adventure?

chapter-done.text: Look how much you have learned! Give yourself a little clap. Now stretch your arms and take a break.
